meta.name: description
meta.content: One connected platform for care teams. Bring client relationships, scheduling, clinical records, billing and family communication together with CareJiox.
The connected operating platform for exceptional care.

div.p: Extraordinary care starts with a team that’s connected. Bring your people, your operations and every step of the care journey into one beautifully simple workspace.

One shared picture.
A whole team moving together.

div.small: A clearer view of the day

div.div: From first hello to ongoing care.
The next person starts with the full story.
A connected view beyond the visit.

div.small: From the first enquiry to the next visit.

div.span: BUILT AROUND THE WAY YOU CARE
div.p: Relationships + Operations + Clinical care + Finance + Insight

div.h2:
Everything connected.
Nothing between you and care.

div.p: From your first conversation to your next decision, CareJiox keeps the details together—so your team can focus on people.

article.h3:
Every conversation.
A meaningful next step.
article.p: Bring enquiries, client profiles and team communication into a shared care workflow. Keep context close and follow-ups moving.

article.h3:
The right care.
In the right place.
article.p: Plan bookings, organise rosters and assign field visits. Give your team a clearer view of who is going where, and what comes next.

article.h3:
The full story.
At the point of care.
article.p: Keep care plans, clinical records, medications, observations and visit notes connected. Support continuity with a shared patient history.

article.h3:
Closer to care.
Even from a distance.
article.p: Support patients and their families with portal access, consent workflows, shared updates and telehealth capabilities.
Manage service pricing, packages, invoice creation and payments, with workflows for claims and filing to government agencies where required.

article.h3:
See the signals.
Know the next step.
article.p: Bring operational dashboards, care monitoring and assisted documentation into the daily workflow, with clinical judgement remaining with your team.

section.p: Capabilities and integrations are configured to your organisation, services and local requirements.

div.p:
Care doesn’t happen in isolated steps.
Your software shouldn’t work that way either.

article.p: Understand the person, capture the enquiry and bring the relationship into focus.
Plan the service, organise the team and make the next visit clear.
Deliver, document and share the information that keeps care moving.
Follow up, keep families informed and connect delivery with billing and insight.

div.a: See how it fits your team ↗

div.h2:
For the people
behind the care.
div.p: Different roles. One shared purpose. Give everyone the context they need to do their best work.
A connected record, a clear plan and a simpler way to document care.
A shared view of bookings, people, schedules and the day ahead.
Connect service delivery to invoices, payments and reporting.
Keep the people who matter connected to the care journey.

details.p: CareJiox supports organisations coordinating home care, community care and clinic services, bringing clinical, operational and business workflows together.

details.summary: Can it fit our local requirements?+
details.p: Service pricing, invoicing and submission workflows can be configured for your organisation. Available integrations and government filing requirements are reviewed as part of your setup.

details.summary: Can our team and families use it on the go?+
details.p: CareJiox includes mobile care workflows, patient and family access, and telehealth capabilities. Access is configured around the roles and services your organisation uses.
Email ash@biztinct.com to arrange a conversation about your services, team and workflows. We’ll walk through the platform with your needs in mind.

section.p: LET’S MAKE SPACE FOR WHAT MATTERS
